First release of **paperless-cf-ocr**, a [Paperless-ngx](https://docs.paperless-ngx.com/) parser plugin. It replaces Tesseract's text with transcriptions from vision language models on **Cloudflare Workers AI**, called through **Cloudflare AI Gateway**. It reads handwriting, form fields and degraded copies far better than Tesseract. Paperless keeps everything else: thumbnails, archive PDFs, workflows and AI suggestions.

## Highlights

- **Plugs into Paperless's parser plugin interface.** It works with native and Docker installs, needs no custom Paperless image and no sidecar service.
- **Default model: Qwen 3.8 27B** (`@cf/qwen/qwen3.8-27b`). Any Workers AI vision model can be used, as can third-party models routed through the gateway (e.g. `anthropic/claude-sonnet-5-5`).
- **Instructions against guessing.** The model is told to write `[illegible]` instead of reconstructing unreadable text. In testing, models without this rule invented plausible text on degraded medical forms.
- **Per-page confidence score** from token log-probabilities, plus an optional **second-opinion model** for low-confidence pages (`PAPERLESS_CF_OCR_SECOND_OPINION=low-confidence|always`).
- **Hybrid archive.** Paperless's own Tesseract/ocrmypdf pipeline still builds the searchable PDF/A, honouring all your OCR settings. The document content comes from the vision model.
- **Handles scans that already have text.** Scanner PDFs with an OCR layer are OCR'd again. Born-digital PDFs keep their text and make no API call (`PAPERLESS_CF_OCR_EXISTING_TEXT=auto|trust|ignore`).
- **Respects Paperless settings:** `PAPERLESS_REMOTE_OCR_MODE=workflow_only`, `PAPERLESS_OCR_MODE`, `PAPERLESS_OCR_PAGES` and `PAPERLESS_OCR_LANGUAGE` (for the local fallback).
- **Reuses Paperless's AI settings** when they already point at the same AI Gateway.
- **Fault-tolerant.** It retries timeouts, rate limits and server errors. Pages that still fail fall back to local Tesseract, so documents are always consumed.

## Install

- **Docker, installer image (recommended):** `ghcr.io/nnmalex/paperless-cf-ocr:0.1.0` (amd64/arm64). See [`deploy/docker/compose.example.yml`](https://github.com/nnmalex/paperless-cf-ocr/blob/v0.1.0/deploy/docker/compose.example.yml). It needs no internet access at Paperless startup and works with rootless containers.
- **Docker, PyPI at startup:** mount [`deploy/docker/init/`](https://github.com/nnmalex/paperless-cf-ocr/tree/v0.1.0/deploy/docker/init) at `/custom-cont-init.d`.
- **Native:** `sudo -Hu paperless pip3 install --no-deps paperless-cf-ocr==0.1.0`

Minimal configuration needs an account ID, a gateway ID and an API token with *Workers AI: Read* and *AI Gateway: Run*. One token is enough, also for authenticated gateways. See the [README](https://github.com/nnmalex/paperless-cf-ocr/blob/v0.1.0/README.md) for all settings.

## Compatibility

- **Paperless-ngx 3.0.5 to 3.5.1.** The latest patch of every 3.x minor release is tested end to end in the official Docker image, and 3.5.1 also against a live Cloudflare gateway.
- Python 3.11–3.14. No runtime dependencies beyond what Paperless ships.

## Known limitations

- **Confidence is a strong signal, not a guarantee.** A model can misread handwriting while being confident, so the second opinion will not catch every error.
- **Old OCR layers stay in the archive.** For scans that already carry an OCR layer, the archive PDF keeps that layer for in-viewer search highlighting. Full-text search uses the new transcription.
- **Workers AI latency varies.** Pages usually take 5–20 s, with occasional spikes up to ~100 s. Pages are processed 4 at a time.
- **Paperless 3.0.x lacks remote-OCR selection.** It has no `PAPERLESS_REMOTE_OCR_MODE`, so the plugin handles every supported document.

## Privacy

Page images are sent to Cloudflare Workers AI. With a third-party second-opinion model, they also go to that provider. **AI Gateway request logging stores full requests and responses**, including your document images and text. Disable log collection on the gateway you use for OCR.

---
Third-party plugins are not supported by the Paperless-ngx maintainers. Reproduce Paperless issues without the plugin before reporting them upstream.
